title: Shockwave | The Calcium Masterclass
overview: Producing a 10 part TV-series style masterclass to teach physicians how to modify calcium in coronary arteries.
body1: The challenge was to educate US interventional cardiologists about the superiority of intravascular lithotripsy for the treatment of calcium, on the eve of their FDA approval.
body2: So we teamed up with Shockwave to produce the ‘Calcium Masterclass’: a high quality, peer-to-peer education program, that attracted over 5500 cardiologists, who spent an average of 28 minutes each learning about the procedure and Shockwave.
body3: Together with Optima Education, we created 10 high-impact classes covering everything from calcium basics to complex patient cases. We also engaged Professor James Spratt and a world-class cardiovascular faculty from Europe & the USA, live from their London studio.
body4: We helped Shockwave dramatically reduce the time from product launch to adoption across all approved markets, delivering 271% revenue growth.
